verdict.rationale: Antigravity's settings docs describe a Telemetry toggle to enable or disable sharing interaction logs used to improve models, which is a first-party opt-out from training use. The evidence is a single thin settings mention, so its scope and guarantees are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what data the toggle covers (code, prompts, files), whether it is on by default, any data-retention or no-training policy commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration that opting out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: toggle Telemetry (enable/disable sharing interaction logs to improve models)
